name: Mythos Gates 3D Blueprint Production Queue
canonAuthority: Lore Director and current canonical game data remain authoritative; queue rows may not invent or alter lore.
productionRule: Environment and Gate blockouts advance before character polish so playable space scale is protected.

lanes.title: Locked Global References
lanes.purpose: Scale, material, and style references that every model package depends on.

lanes.title: Environment + Gate First
lanes.purpose: Playable spaces and realm transition landmarks set scale before character polish.

lanes.title: Deity Silhouette Pass
lanes.purpose: Named deities receive model briefs only after scale and battlefield clearance are proven.

lanes.title: Enemy Readability Pass
lanes.purpose: Threat creatures preserve telegraphs, counterplay, and tactical readability.

lanes.title: NPC Presentation Pass
lanes.purpose: Campaign NPC packages stay non-playable and presentation-safe.

validationRules: Every queue row must point to an existing registry assetId.
Every non-reference queue row depends on the three global references.
Every row must declare priority, lane, phase, sourcePackage, handoffInstruction, and acceptanceCriteria.
No queue row may reference a package outside the canonical 3D_Blueprints registry.
First handoff batch must prioritize non-reference Environment/Gate/Deity production work.
